title: Choose the visual world
question: Homepage + guest scanner for Bank Statement Scanner. The roll assigned The Return. Keep it, take the pick or the standard, or re-roll.

options.label: The Return
options.lineage: US tax and information returns: Form 1040, W-2 Copy A, 1099
options.thesis: The site is a filled-in return: numbered lines, boxed fields, dropout-red rules the scanner ignores and black data it reads.
materials: dropout-red form ink on bright white bond
black typed data in boxed fields
options.viewport: Form header (form number, title, year box) across the top; Line 1 'Attach statement here' is the working drop zone in the left column; Lines 2-4 show free pages, export format and an Ask line with a real answer; Paid Preparer box at the foot.
options.risk: Tax forms carry dread for some visitors; set timidly it reads as a government portal, and the form joke can wear thin on blog pages.

raised.raise: Three inks, no fourth: white paper, dropout red, black data. Every state is made from these.
One human presence: the founder signs the Paid Preparer box with a real name and photo, nothing else.
Live fields only: Line 2 shows this visitor's real free pages left; the form never prints a number that isn't true.
Every transaction line is identical in height and ruling, so a column of amounts reads in one sweep.
Each Part of the form stands as its own cut block with a deep gap, never a run of equal cards.
One governing rule: the line-number gutter runs the full page height and every element hangs from it.

options.label: The Marked-Up Statement
options.lineage: printed bank statements, highlighter and pencil tick marks at a bookkeeper's desk
options.thesis: The page is a printed statement mid-review: asking a question highlights the rows that answer it.
options.viewport: A real-looking statement page fills the left two-thirds; the question 'every payment to John' sits above it and its rows glow yellow with a pencil total in the margin; the drop zone reads 'put your own statement on the desk'.
options.risk: Highlighter-on-paper is a familiar study-tool look many runs land on, and yellow highlight on white needs care to stay legible.

options.label: Kiosk Print
options.lineage: state-office printed goods in three inks
options.thesis: Every page a product cell in three permitted inks.
options.viewport: A kiosk grid of statement cells.
options.risk: Bookkeepers don't recognise it; the grid hides the upload.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no link to statements or tax work, loses both axes.
options.kept: Three-ink discipline: the return uses exactly three inks.

options.label: Highlife Sleeve
options.thesis: A beaming person fronts the work.
options.risk: Reads playful, which the brief rules out.
options.case: Fuses poorly: playful tone around sensitive documents, loses both axes.
options.kept: A person fronts the work: the founder signs the form.

options.label: Minihompy Room
options.thesis: Identity as a room you furnish.
options.risk: Playful and off-subject for client statements.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no bookkeeping resonance, loses both axes.
options.kept: Honest counters: only live, true numbers on the page.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.thesis: Identical channels read in one sweep.
options.viewport: A row of needles behind glass.
options.risk: An instrument costume; nothing to do with statements.
options.case: Fuses poorly: audio tool, loses both axes.
options.kept: Identical rows as the ruler: every transaction line matches.

options.label: Cloud Quarry
options.thesis: Sections cut as blocks with deep gaps.
options.viewport: Cloud blocks cut open on sky.
options.risk: Dreamy where the visitor wants certainty.
options.case: Fuses poorly: surreal mood undermines trust, loses both axes.
options.kept: Cut blocks with deep gaps: each Part stands alone.

options.label: Curved Crease
options.thesis: One line governs the whole layout.
options.viewport: A folded disc and its section.
options.risk: Abstract; says nothing about the product.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no product clarity, loses both axes.
options.kept: One governing rule: the line-number gutter.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean converter SaaS, executed impeccably: product screenshot hero, upload box, honest proof.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and upload box beside a crisp results screenshot, trust strip below.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from DocuClipper and every converter by design.
